verdict.rationale: Meilisearch lists ingestion connectors that reduce custom pipeline work: Meilisync for automatic MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB sync, a Firebase sync integration, ActiveRecord auto-sync for Rails, and a first-party Laravel Scout driver. However, each is only a one-line integration-page mention, and community reports cut against the experience. One user said creating an index and uploading documents took almost a week of coding, and another said the Rails gem fell out of step with the server. Missing for 10: any official web/site crawler, in-depth docs for the connectors (setup, sync semantics, freshness), and independent hands-on confirmation that the connectors replace a custom indexing pipeline.
